# Daily IEC XML Scraper

This repository automatically downloads the International Experience Canada (IEC) selections XML every day and saves it in the `data/` folder. The process is fully automated using GitHub Actions. Note that crawling this endpoint is allowed according to `https://www.ircc.canada.ca/robots.txt`.

**Disclaimer:** This README was in part generated by an LLM.

## Project Structure

```
weekly-scraper/
├── scrape.py                  # Python script that downloads XML
├── requirements.txt           # Python dependencies
├── data/                      # Folder storing daily XML files
│   ├── selections_2026-01-12.xml
│   └── ...
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       └── daily_iec_scraper.yml   # GitHub Actions workflow
└── .gitignore                 # ignores venv, cache files, DS_Store
```

## How It Works

1. The `scrape.py` script fetches the XML from:
   https://ircc.canada.ca/english/work/iec/selections.xml
2. Each file is saved in the `data/` folder with today's date:
   selections_YYYY-MM-DD.xml
3. GitHub Actions workflow (`daily_iec_scraper.yml`) runs the script:
   - Daily at 6 PM Eastern Time
   - Optionally triggered manually via GitHub
4. After running, the workflow **commits the new XML file** back to the repository.
